notes.title: Rocket Escape is on sale for the Steam Spring Sale 2023!
notes.content:
Hello from Compact Square Studios! Rocket Escape is majorly discounted for the Steam Spring Sale 2023! Check it out! If you haven't played the game before, this is a great time to do so, as we've pushed out some fixes to the game since release.

There have been some issues with us being busy and obstacles with creating a major options update to the game, but we would like to get it out at some point. Please know that CS Studios has far from given up on this project.

notes.title: Rocket Escape Soundtrack released!
notes.content:
We have just released the full Rocket Escape original soundtrack via Youtube. It includes all the songs you heard over the course of the game. Give it a listen if you have the time! We hope you enjoy it.

Here's the Youtube link:
https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PL-b2cbX6ogaqBzI92MrtzU22Z0DhPFRUa

notes.title: Happy Holidays from Compact Square Studios!
notes.content:
Hey everybody! We just wanted to wish you all Happy Holidays and hope you are well.

We have more plans for Rocket Escape, including an accessibility/options update coming soon.

We're also coming up with plans for our next game, so stay tuned for that as well!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.4 - Updates
notes.content:
Here it is, our biggest patch yet! Hopefully this makes the game more enjoyable for everyone!

- Updated the rocket to spawn closer to the player when fired next to a wall
- Updated chapter 1, level 12 to use more coherent art assets
- Fixed an issue that would cause the player to lose all momentum when unfocusing the game window
- Fixed an issue regarding firing rockets at the underside of bounce platforms
- Fixed an issue that would cause breakable platforms to break while the game is paused
- Fixed an issue that would cause some animations to play while the game is paused when they were not intended to
- Updated cursors to be constrained to the borders of the screen
- Updated the tutorial to slightly shorten a block to make it clearer that the player has to rocket jump
- Updated the cursor's size to not be affected when the game zooms out
- Fixed an issue regarding the floor's visual position in the tutorial

We're not done! There will be content updates soon since we've ironed out most of the major issues! We look forward to seeing you then!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.4 Slightly Delayed
notes.content:
Hey Rocket Escapers!

We're just giving you a bit of a development update. Patch 1.0.4, which was originally going to come out today, is instead coming out tomorrow. See you then!

notes.title: Minor Patch 1.0.3a - updates
notes.content:
Just a small update to fix a minor issue!

- Fixed the text box scaling in certain areas of the tutorial for the Windows release

Larger update coming later tomorrow!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3 - Updates
notes.content:
Well, here we are again (it's always such a pleasure)
Here are the changes for version 1.0.3:

- Tweaked the rocket physics to give you a small boost when grounded in normal mode (this boost is significantly smaller than the one you would get in easy mode)
- Added a more in-depth explanation to easy mode
- Added an explanation of rocket sweet spots to the tutorial

More patches coming this weekend! Keep on Rocket Escaping!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2 - Updates
notes.content:
Well, I bet it's a sort of surprise to see that blue update button twice in one day! Here are the changes for version 1.0.2:

- Fixed an issue where music from level selected levels could continue to play after beating them and going to the main menu
- Fixed an issue where rockets fired were not reset
- Updated Chapter 1, Level 12 to have a more zoomed out camera so that the player can see more of the level elements

We hope that you are all enjoying the game!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1 - Updates
notes.content:
Hello Rocket Escapers! We're here with the first quick post-launch update. Let's see what has changed!

- Updated Store and library branding images to use a more interesting logo
- Fixed an issue that would cause music to stop playing in certain scenarios
- Fixed an issue that would cause text scaling to appear incorrectly in the Linux version

Thanks for playing Rocket Escape, and we have more updates on the way!

notes.title: Rocket Escape Has Released!
notes.content:
Today is the release date of Rocket Escape. It's available now with a launch discount!

This is just the beginning! We're going to be releasing free updates and possibly dlc(?) in the near future. Now, get Rocket Jumping everyone!
